title: Nonreciprocal entanglement in exciton optomechanics with an optical parametric amplifier
summary: We study nonreciprocal bipartite and tripartite entanglement in a spinning exciton-optomechanical system (EOMS) with an optical parametric amplifier (OPA). We demonstrate that nonreciprocal entanglement among photons, excitons, and phonons can be achieved under experimentally feasible parameters. We find that the nonreciprocal entanglement induced by Sagnac effects can be regulated through the OPA.
